title: Direct and Spillover Effects of Quality Disclosure Regulation: Evidence from California Hospitals
authors: Aishwarrya Deore; Martin Kamil Holzhacker; Ranjani Krishnan
eligible_reason: Single-date DiD: post = 1 for years >= 2004 (California mandatory mortality disclosure) for all hospital-ailment groups; disclosed_post / specialty_post compare disclosed (or complementary specialty) ailments with benchmark ailments within hospital. One adoption date, so not staggered. Every column also adds time-varying hospital-group controls (Elixhauser index, procedures, Medicare/Medicaid shares, beds, margin, HHI) with hospital FE (areg absorb oshpd_id_n), classification FE and year FE.
design_notes: Hospital-year-classification panel from OSHPD/HCAI patient discharge data, 1995-2014. Tables 1-4: areg mortality_rate group_post controls i.classification i.year, absorb(hospital), cluster hospital; matched-ailment benchmark samples in some columns.
estimators_reported: twfe_static (single treatment date) with time-varying controls
ineligible_specs_listed: Tables 1-4: disclosed_post / specialty_post / specialty_specialty_post with time-varying controls; single adoption year 2004
data_files_note: 1_readme.docx: HCAI patient discharge data for 1995-2009 require a data request and are not for circulation; package has cleaning and analysis do-files and a log only.
screener_notes: Not staggered (common 2004 disclosure date); would also fail on controls.
